name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.188.0 — The mocks pipeline now drives a real Vite + React + shadcn app instead of gray HTML wireframes: a new spec/templates/mock/contract.json fixes the one contract with the separate @555/mock-review reviewer package, spec/scripts/lib/mock-cli.js is the sole caller (refusing on a version mismatch or a missing binary with a remedy), and mocks-driver.js is rewritten over SEED → SHELL → SCREENS → THEME → CLIENT → APPROVED with every mark derived from design/notes.json, design/approval.json and check --json; the provenance ledger's verbs and gate are unchanged, and every retired verb from the old HTML-driven driver refuses with a remedy. 7.187.0 — The screen page (/screen/<label>.html, specs/20260913/06) now collapses to one full-width board column on phones: its own grid rule outranked viewer.css's 480px breakpoint, so on a phone the board was squeezed into a ~30px column beside the bottom-sheet inspector. The breakpoint now re-prefixes .rv-screen .rv-main, pinned by a real-Chrome width measurement at 390px and 1280px. 7.186.0 — Every mock has a page you can mark (specs/20260913/06): every atlas card — journey-owned mock, unclaimed mock, or shape — now links to its own screen page at /screen/<label>.html (lib/review-page.js's new buildScreenPage, built from the review page's own board/inspector parts, with no journey rail and no approve control); the lightbox, __full, and every open ↗ link (client- and server-rendered) are deleted outright, and the project panel's jump pill links straight to a drawn screen's page instead of gating on the lightbox. ADR-0027 narrows specs/20260912/05 D4 and specs/20260905/01 D3.
